description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex. No. 1933/09 of 21.09.2015 D/S Division, Wennappuwa
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying parcel numbers, land extents, and encumbrances related to specific land parcels. It contains detailed descriptions of land locations, cadastral maps, and property rights, making it primarily about land and property matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
